entries.source: Explore Alanya Panorama, Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach and the Damlataş area on a sunset city tour with hotel transfer, guide service, insurance and round-trip cable-car ticket included.
entries.translation: Explore Alanya Panorama, Alanya Castle, Cleopatra Beach and the Damlataş area on a sunset city tour with hotel transfer, guide service, insurance and round-trip cable-car ticket included.

entries.source: Panorama • Alanya Castle • Round-Trip Cable Car • Cleopatra Beach • Damlataş Area
entries.translation: Panorama • Alanya Castle • Round-Trip Cable Car • Cleopatra Beach • Damlataş Area

entries.source: Discover Alanya’s main viewpoints and historic castle district, ride the cable car, enjoy free time and seasonal swimming at Cleopatra Beach, and explore the Damlataş area.
entries.translation: Discover Alanya’s main viewpoints and historic castle district, ride the cable car, enjoy free time and seasonal swimming at Cleopatra Beach, and explore the Damlataş area.

entries.source: Alanya Sunset City Tour is an afternoon and evening route combining the city’s panoramic terrace, castle district, cable car and famous western coastline.
entries.translation: Alanya Sunset City Tour is an afternoon and evening route combining the city’s panoramic terrace, castle district, cable car and famous western coastline.

entries.source: The bus makes confirmed stops at the Alanya panoramic terrace and in the castle area before continuing to Cleopatra Beach and the Damlataş district.
entries.translation: The bus makes confirmed stops at the Alanya panoramic terrace and in the castle area before continuing to Cleopatra Beach and the Damlataş district.

entries.source: A round-trip cable-car ticket is included. The cable car connects the Damlataş area with the upper castle district and offers elevated views of Cleopatra Beach, the city and the Mediterranean.
entries.translation: A round-trip cable-car ticket is included. The cable car connects the Damlataş area with the upper castle district and offers elevated views of Cleopatra Beach, the city and the Mediterranean.

entries.source: At Cleopatra Beach, guests receive free time for relaxing and seasonal swimming, subject to weather and sea conditions. Damlataş Cave can be visited during the stop; its entrance fee is paid separately unless otherwise confirmed.
entries.translation: At Cleopatra Beach, guests receive free time for relaxing and seasonal swimming, subject to weather and sea conditions. Damlataş Cave can be visited during the stop; its entrance fee is paid separately unless otherwise confirmed.
